changelog:
v2.13.1 - The app updates itself

- NEW: silent self-install through Shizuku. On every launch Empire checks for a new version, downloads it, verifies the signature, installs it with no installer screen and no tapping.
- Split Screen: floating bubble splits your saved pair of apps from inside ANY app, one tap.
- If Shizuku is off, it falls back to the normal prompt instead of failing quietly.
